2026-09-24 热门论文 Top 10

机器人 · 强化学习 · 通用 AI

生成时间：2026-09-24 09:02 CST。从 677 篇近 30 天的候选论文中筛选。优先保留机器人与强化学习各最多 3 篇，再按分数补齐；最终按分数排列。领域由标题、摘要和关键词自动识别，可能有误差。

候选来源：Hugging Face Papers 和启用个性化时的 arXiv 新论文。热度分结合热榜位置、点赞、讨论、时间衰减及已观测到的增长；不代表学术质量，也不覆盖全部 arXiv 论文。

已启用 Zotero-arXiv-Daily 加权摘要相似度：相关性 65%，热度与新鲜度 35%；近期收藏权重更高。

规则标签：视觉语言动作

Gemini 暂不可用，显示规则标签与原文摘要。

原文摘要节选：Manipulation policies must know which objects matter and where they are, yet the pretrained backbones that current robot foundation models build on, from language in vision-language-action models (VLAs) to video generation in world-action models (WAMs), do not directly require this metric grounding, leaving it to be learned implicitly from robot demonstrations. We propose Grounded Action Models (GAMs), a new paradigm of robot foundation models built with 3D grounding. GAM can be conditioned using language, points, or box prompts, which are first transformed into a shared object-centric representation of the selected objects. This representation captures target-focused visual features and metric object geometry, which is mixed with robot state history through a multi-stream transformer to…

2. From Pretraining to Proficiency: Real-World Subtask RL for Long-Horizon Manipulation with Minimal Human Intervention

机器人 / 强化学习 · 发表 2026-09-18 · 综合分 5.72

Zotero 摘要相关性：0.539（相似度分数，不是概率）。

HF 点赞 12 · 讨论 2

较上次观测（1.0 天前）：点赞 +7 · 讨论 +0。

规则标签：强化学习

中文概述：针对机器人长序列操作任务中预训练策略在关键子任务上的失败问题，本文提出了PARTS框架。该方法通过引入子任务选择器和成功验证器，专注于瓶颈环节的强化学习微调。在保持预训练策略作为基础动作输出的同时，利用局部奖励信号指导残差策略学习，减少了对完整任务演示和人工干预的依赖。实验表明，该方法在双臂及单臂任务中显著提升了整体任务的成功率。

基于摘要 · Gemini 生成，未经全文核验。

  • PARTS框架通过在瓶颈环节集中练习，并利用局部奖励进行残差修正，有效解决了长序列任务中稀疏奖励的学习困难。
    摘要依据：We present PARTS (Policy Adaptation with RL on Targeted Subtasks), a real-world subtask RL framework that concentrates practice at these bottlenecks while allowing training rollouts to proceed with minimal human intervention.
  • 在相同机器人部署预算下，PARTS相较于现有微调方法，将完整任务成功率提升了超过25%，且降低了人工操作需求。
    摘要依据：Compared with existing real-world RL fine-tuning methods, PARTS raises full-task success by more than 25% under the same robot-rollout budget while requiring less human involvement.

AI 主题：机器人操作 · 强化学习 · Sim-to-Real

原文摘要节选：A pretrained robot foundation policy may execute most of a long-horizon task yet repeatedly fail at a few critical subtasks. Collecting additional full-task demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) requires operators to repeat behaviors the policy already performs well. Reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning offers a promising path to bridge this gap, but existing approaches struggle to solve long-horizon tasks using only sparse rewards. We present PARTS (Policy Adaptation with RL on Targeted Subtasks), a real-world subtask RL framework that concentrates practice at these bottlenecks while allowing training rollouts to proceed with minimal human intervention. The frozen pretrained policy supplies nominal actions throughout execution, while agent-generated selectors and success…

3. Transferring the Intelligence of VLMs to Robotic Control

机器人 · 发表 2026-09-19 · 综合分 5.51

Zotero 摘要相关性：0.477（相似度分数，不是概率）。

HF 点赞 104 · 讨论 3

较上次观测（1.0 天前）：点赞 +3 · 讨论 +1。

中文概述：本文探讨了视觉语言模型（VLM）在数字世界到物理世界任务中的泛化潜力。作者提出了RoboDawn接口，通过离散化控制指令使VLM能够闭环控制机器人。结合上下文学习（ICL）方案，该模型无需任务特定的机器人训练即可执行操作。实验结果显示，RoboDawn在多个机器人基准测试中优于现有的基准策略，并能在真实世界的Franka机器人上实现物体堆叠等操作，展示了其跨环境的迁移能力。

基于摘要 · Gemini 生成，未经全文核验。

  • 提出RoboDawn接口，利用离散控制指令实现VLM对机器人的闭环控制，且无需进行任务特定的机器人训练。
    摘要依据：We investigate this question through RoboDawn, a human-intuitive interface that exposes robotic control to an agentic VLM through a compact set of discrete translation, rotation, and gripper commands. Using this interface, the VLM controls a robot in a closed loop: it observes the current visual state, reasons about the next action, executes it, and adapts subsequent decisions to the resulting state.
  • 引入上下文学习方案，通过少量演示示例显著提升了模型在任务执行中的成功率。
    摘要依据：Furthermore, we introduce an in-context learning (ICL) scheme that uses a few demonstrations to ground the VLM in both interface usage and task-solving strategies.
  • 实验证明RoboDawn在零样本和单样本设置下均表现出色，并在RoboTwin 2.0 C2R和RoboDojo等基准测试中超越了现有基准策略。
    摘要依据：In the zero-shot setting, RoboDawn outperforms several strong policies trained on benchmarkspecific robot data, while a single in-context demonstration further yields substantial performance gains and establishes state-of-the-art (SOTA) results.

AI 主题：机器人操作 · Sim-to-Real · 视觉语言动作

原文摘要节选：Humans can seamlessly adapt to both physical and digital worlds, suggesting that while a digital-to-real gap exists in embodiment, environment and task, human intelligence itself may transfer across this gap. This naturally raises a fundamental question: can the intelligence of vision-language models (VLMs) similarly generalize from the digital world to the physical world for robotic control? We investigate this question through RoboDawn, a human-intuitive interface that exposes robotic control to an agentic VLM through a compact set of discrete translation, rotation, and gripper commands. Using this interface, the VLM controls a robot in a closed loop: it observes the current visual state, reasons about the next action, executes it, and adapts subsequent decisions to the resulting state.…

4. MintAct: A Unified Visual Agent for Digital Environments

强化学习 · 发表 2026-09-18 · 综合分 5.43

Zotero 摘要相关性：0.465（相似度分数，不是概率）。

HF 点赞 30 · 讨论 1

较上次观测（1.0 天前）：点赞 +16 · 讨论 +0。

规则标签：强化学习 · 导航

中文概述：本文提出了MintAct，这是一个包含2B、4B和8B参数规模的视觉语言模型系列，旨在统一数字环境中的UI定位、跨平台多步导航以及视觉工具使用。作者通过构建可扩展的环境与异步强化学习基础设施，优化了跨域训练分布。实验结果表明，该模型在多个基准测试中达到了与领域专用模型相当的性能，并在OSWorld-Verified测试中取得了48.9分的成绩。

基于摘要 · Gemini 生成，未经全文核验。

  • MintAct通过统一的设计实现了单一模型在UI定位、跨平台导航及视觉工具使用任务上与领域专用模型相当的性能。
    摘要依据：Through careful design of our environments, data, and training recipes, MintAct models match the performance of per-domain specialists across all of these capabilities.
  • 该研究开发了一种异步强化学习框架，能有效处理跨域训练分布，并在噪声环境反馈和离线策略漂移下保持稳定。
    摘要依据：To enable efficient and scalable RL training, an asynchronous framework keeps explicit control over the cross-domain training distribution and remains stable under noisy environment feedback and off-policy drift.
  • MintAct模型在OSWorld-Verified基准测试上取得了48.9分，在同等模型规模下展现了最先进的性能。
    摘要依据：Experimental results show that MintAct achieves state-of-the-art performance (48.9 on OSWorld-Verified) across a wide range of benchmarks at comparable model sizes.

AI 主题：强化学习 · 推理

原文摘要节选：We present MintAct, a family of vision-language models that unifies UI grounding, multi-step navigation across mobile, desktop, and web, and visual tool use, trained at 2B, 4B, and 8B scales. Through careful design of our environments, data, and training recipes, MintAct models match the performance of per-domain specialists across all of these capabilities. To enable this, we develop a scalable environment and reinforcement learning (RL) infrastructure. On the environment side, we host hundreds of concurrent instances across heterogeneous per-domain backends, serving both trajectory data collection and online RL. To enable efficient and scalable RL training, an asynchronous framework keeps explicit control over the cross-domain training distribution and remains stable under noisy…

5. RRSI: Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses

通用 AI · 发表 2026-09-21 · 综合分 5.23

Zotero 摘要相关性：0.364（相似度分数，不是概率）。

HF 点赞 176 · 讨论 2 · 本次 HF 热榜第 9 位 · 仓库累计 Star 190（仓库可能包含多篇论文）

较上次观测（1.0 天前）：点赞 +22 · 讨论 +1 · Star +136。

中文概述：针对大语言模型智能体框架（harness）递归自我改进过程中出现的过拟合现象，本文提出了一种正则化递归自我改进方法（RRSI）。该方法通过在候选建议阶段引入时间退火预算与轨迹探索机制，并在选择阶段配备评估器与修剪器，旨在限制针对特定任务的过度优化，从而提升框架的泛化能力和效率。实验结果表明，该方法在多个任务基准上实现了性能提升，并降低了策略词元开销。

基于摘要 · Gemini 生成，未经全文核验。

  • RRSI通过正则化约束候选建议与选择过程，有效缓解了递归进化中因记忆训练任务导致的过拟合问题，增强了智能体机制的泛化性。
    摘要依据：We introduce Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses (RRSI), which incorporates the principles of regularizations into harness self-improvement by constraining the evolution candidate proposal and selection.
  • 在八个任务基准测试中，RRSI不仅在训练分布上获得性能提升，在分布外基准上最高提升了4.7个点，且大幅降低了推理成本。
    摘要依据：Across eight benchmarks spanning coding, agentic workspace and engineering design tasks, RRSI gains up to 14.1 points on the split it evolves against and up to 4.7 points on the five out-of-distribution benchmarks, while producing a harness that runs on 30% fewer policy tokens than the unregularized evolution.

AI 主题：大模型后训练 · 推理

原文摘要节选：An LLM agent's capability is largely magnified by its harness, namely the prompts, control flow, tooling, memory, and context management surrounding the frozen backbone model. Recent methods increasingly automate this process by iteratively proposing and selecting component-wise edits of an agent harness, practically establishing a form of recursive self-improvement (RSI) at the agent-system level. However, such recursive evolution may overfit by memorizing the training tasks, showing large in-distribution gains that shrink or even vanish on out-of-distribution benchmarks. We introduce Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses (RRSI), which incorporates the principles of regularizations into harness self-improvement by constraining the evolution candidate proposal and…

通用 AI · 发表 2026-09-21 · 综合分 5.21

Zotero 摘要相关性：0.355（相似度分数，不是概率）。

HF 点赞 125 · 讨论 4 · 本次 HF 热榜第 1 位 · 仓库累计 Star 288（仓库可能包含多篇论文）

较上次观测（1.0 天前）：点赞 +12 · 讨论 +1 · Star +94。

规则标签：世界模型

中文概述：针对视频世界模型在长序列与多视角下难以保持一致性的问题，作者提出了WorldCrafter。该模型通过引入可查询的隐式3D感知记忆机制，利用记忆编码器和姿态条件读取模块，将多视角历史观测压缩至固定数量的视角相关Token中，结合时间上下文与蒸馏技术，实现了从单张图片或文本提示出发的场景流式探索。实验表明，该方法在长序列一致性与相机控制准确性方面具有显著提升。

基于摘要 · Gemini 生成，未经全文核验。

  • 提出了一种隐式3D感知记忆机制，通过视角引导将多视角历史观测压缩至有限的Token预算中，从而增强了视频生成的一致性。
    摘要依据：The key insight is to let the requested viewpoint shape how multi-view evidence is compressed into the video generator's limited token budget.
  • WorldCrafter能够支持长达分钟级的场景探索，并在保持视觉质量的同时，显著提高了长序列的一致性和相机控制精度。
    摘要依据：Experiments across static and dynamic scenes show substantial gains in long-horizon consistency and camera-control accuracy while preserving visual quality during minute-scale exploration.

AI 主题：世界模型

原文摘要节选：Video world models enable interactive exploration of dynamic environments, yet struggle to respect prior observations over long horizons and across viewpoints. We present WorldCrafter, a video world model that learns a camera-queryable implicit 3D-aware memory for this purpose. The key insight is to let the requested viewpoint shape how multi-view evidence is compressed into the video generator's limited token budget. Trained jointly with the video generator, a memory encoder and pose-conditioned readout module integrate historical observations into a fixed set of target view-specific tokens before denoising, without explicit depth-based correspondences. By combining this memory with recent temporal context and few-step distillation, WorldCrafter enables streaming scene exploration from a…

中文概述：为了实现机器人在未知环境中的适应性，本文提出了一种名为GPT-Policy的通用智能体框架，旨在通过上下文学习（ICL）使机器人无需梯度更新即可从演示、示例和交互反馈中学习任务。该框架整合了上下文编译器、视觉语言模型（VLM）及约束控制器，能将信息转换为可验证的机器人行为。实验表明，该方法在真实机器人任务中能够通过人类视频演示和动作参考提升任务完成率，为VLM在实体机器人上的应用提供了实证基础。

基于摘要 · Gemini 生成，未经全文核验。

  • GPT-Policy框架通过上下文编译器、VLM动作规划和约束控制器，实现了无需梯度更新的上下文机器人学习。
    摘要依据：GPT-Policy integrates a context compiler that preserves task-relevant visual transitions, a VLM that proposes robot-tool actions, and a constrained controller that verifies and executes each action and reports its outcome.
  • 在真实机器人实验中，即使没有机器人动作标签，引入人类视频演示也能有效提升任务完成效果。
    摘要依据：In real-robot trials, human video demonstrations improve task completion even without robot action labels, while aligned action references yield further gains on contact-sensitive tasks.

AI 主题：视觉语言动作

9. One to More, More to One: Category-Aware Iterative Expert Training for Software Engineering Agents

强化学习 · 发表 2026-09-20 · 综合分 5.04

Zotero 摘要相关性：0.368（相似度分数，不是概率）。

HF 点赞 31 · 讨论 4 · 本次 HF 热榜第 18 位 · 仓库累计 Star 39（仓库可能包含多篇论文）

较上次观测（1.0 天前）：点赞 +15 · 讨论 +2。

规则标签：强化学习

中文概述：针对软件工程（SWE）智能体在多任务学习中表现不均衡的问题，作者提出了一种类别感知的专家训练与策略整合框架。该框架通过SWE Labeler系统进行任务分类，结合长周期Agentic-miniRL与“刷新-修复-扩展”（RRE）机制迭代训练类别专家，并利用标签路由的多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）将专家模型整合为单一学生模型。实验结果显示，该方法在Pro-618和SWE-bench Multilingual基准测试上均提升了任务解决率。

基于摘要 · Gemini 生成，未经全文核验。

  • 提出一种名为MOPD的多教师在线策略蒸馏方法，通过ReLU门控奖励外推技术，将多个类别专家的优势整合至单一模型中。
    摘要依据：Label-routed multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) consolidates the experts into one deployable student, with ReLU-gated reward extrapolation keeping only each teacher's improving direction over the reference.
  • 该框架无需外部模型提供动作目标或解法轨迹，即可实现专家训练与策略整合。
    摘要依据：Expert training and policy integration require no external model to provide solution trajectories or action targets.

AI 主题：强化学习 · 推理

原文摘要节选：Repository-level software engineering (SWE) comprises heterogeneous task categories, whose progress under pooled agentic reinforcement learning can be uneven: gains in some categories coincide with regressions in others, while aggregate resolution obscures these changes. Motivated by this category see-saw, we develop a category-aware expert-training and policy-integration framework. Executable task construction and SWE Labeler, an evidence-grounded multi-axis labeling system, organize the training pools.     摘要依据：From occupancy and ego-velocity histories, a recurrent predictor forecasts future occupancy over a 1 s horizon by warping the current map with learned flow and visibility gates.
  • 在Isaac Lab仿真测试中，LOOP的避障表现优于重训练的反应式基线，并在实机部署中表现稳定。
    摘要依据：In encounter-synchronised Isaac Lab evaluations, LOOP achieves 57.1% head-on success at obstacle speeds of 2.5-3.2 m/s, exceeding a retrained reactive baseline by 8.2 percentage points.

AI 主题：足式运动 · 导航

原文摘要节选：Legged robots under sparse waypoint guidance must avoid moving obstacles using partial, rapidly changing LiDAR observations. We present LOOP (Latent-recurrent Occupancy rollOut Policy), a local avoidance policy that connects sparse waypoint guidance to a frozen locomotion controller at 50 Hz. From occupancy and ego-velocity histories, a recurrent predictor forecasts future occupancy over a 1 s horizon by warping the current map with learned flow and visibility gates. These maps guide velocity selection through map-derived features and geometric risk estimates, providing an explicit interface for inspecting and replacing predictions. In encounter-synchronised Isaac Lab evaluations, LOOP achieves 57.1% head-on success at obstacle speeds of 2.5-3.2 m/s, exceeding a retrained reactive…

基于摘要 · Gemini 生成，未经全文核验。

    摘要依据：To bridge these gaps, we introduce MotionForge, the first large- scale simulation benchmark and data-generation pipeline tailored to jointly evaluate domain shifts and long-horizon interaction in dynamic manipulation.
  • 该基准支持对单因素及包含背景、光照、物体和速度变化的联合领域迁移进行系统性鲁棒性评估。
    摘要依据：Our benchmark introduces two key novelties: (1) a systematic evaluation protocol for assessing policy robustness under both single-factor (e.g., only backgrounds shift) and joint domain shifts (e.g., simultaneous shifts of objects, backgrounds, lighting, and speed)

    摘要依据：We further validate Verti-WM using real-world data, enabling policy optimization within learned real-world kinodynamics and achieving a 80% success rate on the Verti-4-Wheeler platform, compared with 40% for direct sim-to-real transfer.

    摘要依据：Joint supervision prevents this one-sided specialization, preserving consequence prediction and preparing the policy for downstream exploration.

AI 主题：人形机器人 · 导航 · 强化学习 · Sim-to-Real

规则标签：世界模型 · 视觉语言动作

中文概述：针对物理人工智能领域，作者提出了“机器人数据工厂”（RDF）这一基础设施与方法论。RDF不再将静态数据集作为最终目标，而是通过组织异构机器人与环境，构建包括任务、技能、感知与结果在内的“机器人经验”。该系统通过“部署-测量-学习-循环”的闭环流程，支持世界模型、视觉语言动作模型及具身智能策略的开发，旨在将机器人数据生成转变为可重复、可扩展的科学生产过程。

基于摘要 · Gemini 生成，未经全文核验。

  • 提出RDF架构，通过“部署-测量-学习”闭环替代静态数据集，以持续生成、验证并复用包含完整感知-动作-结果链条的机器人经验。
    摘要依据：Rather than treating datasets as static end products, RDF implements a closed Deploy-Measure-Learn-Repeat cycle in which validated physical experience supports world models, vision-language-action models, embodied policies, digital twins, and subsequent robot deployment.
  • 作者形式化了机器人经验及质量标准，推导出了关联机器人规模、计算资源与感知能力的量化缩放定律。
    摘要依据：We further formalize robot experience and its quality, introduce a mission-task-skill-episode-dataset-benchmark-capability hierarchy, and derive quantitative scaling laws and an algorithmic synthesis procedure connecting robot fleet size, sensor rates, storage, learning representations, tokenization, training compute, inference, and latency to Embodied-AI cluster requirements.

We argue that the defining scientific resource of Physical AI is therefore not raw robot data alone, but robot experience - physically grounded interaction whose observations, actions, embodiment, context, and outcomes preserve the perception-action-consequence loop. We introduce the Robot Data Factory (RDF), a mission-driven infrastructure and methodology for continuously generating, validating, benchmarking, and reusing such experience. RDF organizes heterogeneous robots and environment-specific training grounds through reproducible missions, skill curricula, synchronized multimodal sensing, external ground truth, an agentic robot…

With a shared video backbone between the policy and simulator, we use action-unlabeled video to learn visual dynamics and action-labeled human and robot demonstrations to jointly learn video and action prediction. Building on this architecture, a coarse-to-fine training…

基于摘要 · Gemini 生成，未经全文核验。

  • Neverwhere基准测试套件通过集成60多个基于3D高斯溅射重建的真实场景，为机器人评估提供了一个高逼真的封闭循环环境。
    摘要依据：This work intends to narrow this train/evaluation gap by developing a collection of hyper-photo-realistic, closed-loop evaluation environments - The Neverwhere Benchmark Suite - comprised of over sixty 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructions of urban indoor and outdoor scenes.
  • 研究通过实验分析指出，仅依赖3D高斯生成的训练数据存在局限性，并强调了引入多样化数据对于提升策略泛化能力至关重要。
    摘要依据：We also underscore the potential pitfalls of relying exclusively on 3D Gaussian-generated data for training, by providing policy checkpoints trained over multiple Neverwhere scenes and their performance when evaluated in novel scenes. Our analysis illustrates the necessity of sourcing diverse data to ensure performance.

原文摘要节选：State-of-the-art visual locomotion controllers are increasingly capable at handling complex visual environments, making evaluating their real-world performance before deployment increasingly difficult. This work intends to narrow this train/evaluation gap by developing a collection of hyper-photo-realistic, closed-loop evaluation environments - The Neverwhere Benchmark Suite - comprised of over sixty 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructions of urban indoor and outdoor scenes. Our goal is to encourage large-scale and reproducible robot evaluation by making it easier to create and integrate Gaussian splats-based reconstructions into simulated continuous testing setups. We also underscore the potential pitfalls of relying exclusively on 3D Gaussian-generated data for training, by providing…

机器人 · 公告 2026-09-16 · 综合分 3.06

Zotero 摘要相关性：0.471（相似度分数，不是概率）。

规则标签：视觉语言动作

中文概述：本文提出了内在机器人奖励（IRR）方法，旨在复用视觉-语言-动作（VLA）系统的视觉表征与演示数据，实现机器人自主评估任务结果并提供策略改进反馈。该方法通过在现有流水线中加入参考库与评分机制，无需额外的评估器或感知骨干网络，旨在降低集成难度、提高奖励计算效率并减少人工评估需求。作者通过COMAU Racer 3实验平台验证了该方法的可行性。

基于摘要 · Gemini 生成，未经全文核验。

  • IRR方法通过复用预训练的视觉编码器和演示数据，实现了无需额外学习评估器的自主任务结果评估。
    摘要依据：The core reward mechanism adds a reference bank and a scoring operation to the existing pipeline, without requiring a separate learned evaluator or an additional perception backbone.
  • 该方法通过简化感知与评价流程，旨在降低工业机器人系统的集成难度并提升从已有数据中学习的效率。
    摘要依据：Our position is that this reuse offers a promising route to lower integration effort, efficient reward computation, and reduced recurring human outcome scoring.

AI 主题：机器人操作 · 视觉语言动作 · Sim-to-Real

原文摘要节选：Vision-language-action (VLA) systems already bring together two valuable resources for robot learning: rich visual representations and demonstrations of successful task execution. Intrinsic Robot Rewarding (IRR) proposes to use these resources for a second, complementary purpose: evaluating the robot's own outcomes and providing feedback for policy improvement. Successful demonstration endpoints define task-specific references, and the policy's frozen visual encoder provides the feature space in which new outcomes are assessed. The core reward mechanism adds a reference bank and a scoring operation to the existing pipeline, without requiring a separate learned evaluator or an additional perception backbone. Our position is that this reuse offers a promising route to lower integration…

机器人 · 公告 2026-09-16 · 综合分 3.04

Zotero 摘要相关性：0.467（相似度分数，不是概率）。

arXiv 新论文；暂无 HF 热度数据，主要根据 Zotero 相关性推荐。

规则标签：人形机器人

中文概述：针对人形机器人全身移动操作任务探索不足的问题，研究提出了WholeBodyWAM模型。该方法通过联合预测未来的视觉动力学、操作动作及全身控制意图，在保留预训练世界-动作先验的同时，引入全身控制器（WBC）语义接地与行为协调。实验结果表明，该模型在模拟环境和真实世界中均提升了任务成功率及泛化能力，为通过结构化接地实现可扩展的人形机器人智能提供了方案。

基于摘要 · Gemini 生成，未经全文核验。

  • WholeBodyWAM 通过集成全身控制器（WBC）语义接地与协调机制，将预训练的世界-动作先验扩展至人形机器人的移动操作任务中。
    摘要依据：It preserves pre-trained world-action priors while grounding heterogeneous whole-body controller (WBC) semantics and coordinating whole-body behavior.
  • 实验表明该方法在模拟任务中实现了91.9%的成功率，并能有效减少不同WBC实现之间的成功率差异。
    摘要依据：Extensive experiments show that WholeBodyWAM achieves an overall simulation task success rate of 91.9%, with a 0.23 improvement in real-world out-of-distribution task progress and a 70% reduction in success-rate variance across WBCs relative to the respective baselines.
